newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends little changed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends little changed in quiet trade.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed barely changed against its American counterpart in listless Saturday trade as players retreated to the sidelines, dealers said.
The local dollar closed at T$27.500 against Friday's T$27.505 end. Turnover through dealers was a light US$49 million in the shortened Saturday session.
"There is very little activity today and there is no direction," said one dealer.
But dealers expected some year-end commercial demand for the U.S. dollar to continue to emerge next week. A range of T$27.48-52 was seen.
